title: Detailed Christmas tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- trunk -->
  <rect x='44' y='82' width='12' height='14' rx='2' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='44' y='82' width='12' height='4' rx='1' fill='#A0703A'/>

  <!-- bottom tier -->
  <polygon points='50,38 18,82 82,82' fill='#1E7B34'/>
  <polygon points='50,38 18,82 50,82' fill='#2A9B46'/>
  <polygon points='50,38 50,82 82,82' fill='#16702A'/>

  <!-- middle tier -->
  <polygon points='50,24 26,64 74,64' fill='#22963C'/>
  <polygon points='50,24 26,64 50,64' fill='#36B050'/>
  <polygon points='50,24 50,64 74,64' fill='#1A7E30'/>

  <!-- top tier -->
  <polygon points='50,10 34,46 66,46' fill='#2AA844'/>
  <polygon points='50,10 34,46 50,46' fill='#42C25C'/>
  <polygon points='50,10 50,46 66,46' fill='#1E9436'/>

  <!-- snow on edges -->
  <path d='M18,82 Q24,78 30,82 Q36,78 42,82 Q48,78 54,82 Q60,78 66,82 Q72,78 78,82 Q80,80 82,82' fill='#E8F4FF' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M26,64 Q32,60 38,64 Q44,60 50,64 Q56,60 62,64 Q68,60 74,64' fill='#E8F4FF' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M34,46 Q40,42 44,46 Q48,42 50,46 Q54,42 58,46 Q62,42 66,46' fill='#E8F4FF' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- garlands -->
  <path d='M24,72 Q37,66 50,72 Q63,78 76,72' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30,54 Q40,48 50,54 Q60,60 70,54' stroke='#FF6B6B' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38,36 Q44,32 50,36 Q56,40 62,36' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- ornaments -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='74' r='3' fill='#FF3B3B'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#4DA6FF'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='78' r='3' fill='#FF3B3B'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='3' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#4DA6FF'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='2' fill='#FF3B3B'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='40' r='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='2' fill='#FF6B6B'/>

  <!-- candy cane -->
  <path d='M72,66 Q76,62 76,58 Q76,54 72,54' stroke='#FF3B3B' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72,66 Q76,62 76,58 Q76,54 72,54' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-dasharray='2,2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- star -->
  <polygon points='50,2 52,8 58,8 53,12 55,18 50,14 45,18 47,12 42,8 48,8' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='50,4 51,8 55,8 52,10 53,14 50,12 47,14 48,10 45,8 49,8' fill='#FFF4A0'/>

  <!-- star glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='6' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.15'/>
</svg>
